text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Ikuno Dictus and her friends 
invited me out, and we spent a fun day off 
together.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The haunted house was so much fun—!! And 
thanks to Ikuno, we didn't even have to 
wait in line!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, it is simply because everyone is 
moving according to schedule.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now, next up is the roller coaster. It's 
before noon, so it shouldn't be crowded.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, having you around really keeps things 
running smoothly, Ikuno-san! Well then, 
shall we head on over—

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Attendant
text_block_list.text: "‘The All-In Parade will now begin!’"

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Attendant
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone can participate in the parade! 
Please feel free to join in♪"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's that dance-walk thing! Can we really 
do that with everyone!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Dancing through the streets with everyone 
would surely make for a brilliant sight... 
Hmm, this could work for public 
relations...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fantastico! Let us join in at once!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nice, nice! Let's all have a parade!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold on! The roller coaster's 
next, right... Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...A parade, is it? ......All right, let's 
go...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? What about the schedule Ikuno 
made!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Even in a parade, Turbo takes the lead! 
Heave-ho! Heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna let loose too~~! Haa~~n, 
yoiyasa~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Vivace! Performing in front of an audience 
really gets the heart racing, after all!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Enjoying this very moment with my 
friends...! Moments of youth like this 
would make anyone emotional!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Screw it, I'm throwing caution to the 
wind! Might as well enjoy it! Heave-ho~♪"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we went around the park three 
whole times in the parade...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...So, a roller coaster now? I doubt you'd 
change the schedule without thinking, 
Ikuno—is now our best chance or something?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. I don't think we can catch it now. I 
didn't really think of any 
countermeasures.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: !? Are you serious? No plan? Ikuno??

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We can ride the roller coaster 
anytime.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, marching in a parade alongside 
friends isn't something one gets to do 
every day.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If I miss this chance, I know I'll regret 
it in the years to come... That's what I 
thought."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...And above all, it feels like it'll be 
even more thrilling than a roller coaster! 
...She said."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There goes Ikuno, playing along again! 
...Well, it was pretty fun, not gonna lie.
choice_data_list: Everyone was really getting into it!

Looks like you'll sleep soundly tonight, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There goes Ikuno, playing along again! 
...Well, it was pretty fun, not gonna lie.
choice_data_list: Everyone was really getting into it!

Looks like you'll sleep soundly tonight, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did I get a little too carried away? 
I was giving it my all to get into the 
groove, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I showed Ikuno Dictus the video I had 
recorded.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Ikuno is smiling! And she's 
stepping to the beat, totally grooving!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That was flawless sharpness. Giving it 
your all was well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a pleasant kind of fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The plans changed, but you still left us 
even more satisfied than before. Color me 
impressed!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I am honored by your praise.
